desc:
[Inspired by Undertale Soul OPs, a Tower Defense game but YOU are the Towers.]

Welcome to Undertale: The Multiverse Killer.
A collapsing multiverse. A hunted Soul. And you — the only thing standing between it and total erasure.

< Keybinds: >
- T/D-Pads to Ping.

< Type "/cmds" for commands >

< Current Version: v1.1.5F >
< Events: N/A >

< The game is currently in its Beta phase. Because of this, you should expect some bugs and rough edges! >

< Shutdowns = Updates, hotfixes, or balance tweaks. >
